envelope.description: Resolve the approval class, the effective mode and the request

body.title: Resolve the approval class, the effective mode and the request
body.summary: Add the pure resolution used by the executor (src/daemon/tools/approval-policy.ts): the class from the field or the per-input function (a function that throws counts as destructive; absent means none), the rule for whether to ask (destructive always; common when the effective mode, deps.approvalMode else tools.commonApproval, is manual or edit-auto; none never), and the request builder (repository from input cwd then deps.repoPath, the exact arguments truncated for display with the length noted, the preview from buildApprovalGate with a generic preview if it throws, a 300 second expiry). No broker and no IO.
acceptanceChecks: a destructive tool asks for every approvalMode, every tools.commonApproval value, any caller and any argument
a common tool asks in manual and edit-auto and not in auto, with the call's approvalMode over the flag
a throwing class function resolves to destructive
the request names the tool, the repository and the untruncated-length of large arguments
a missing buildApprovalGate or one that throws gives a generic preview
